style: Retro lounge exotica and doo-wop vocal-group pop; [HARMONY SYSTEM] Barber-shop voice leading with non-diatonic cluster rubs, parallel major thirds sliding into suspended quartal fields, and ringing dominant tension; [MELODIC SYSTEM] Fast scat-like contour with yodel register flips, chromatic patter, and ornamental folk turns; [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] Waltz pulse invaded by swinging triplet subdivisions and abrupt metric compression stops; [TIMBRE SYSTEM] Upright bass, brushed snare, parlor organ, spring-reverb surf guitar, and close-miked vocal group; [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] Theatrical overstatement delivered with deadpan administrative precision; [ANCHOR] A persistent walking bassline that anchors mutating vocal harmonies. Operators: hold the walking bass fixed while vocal clusters migrate; compress lyrical meter while stretching spatial reverb tails; make doo-wop harmonies behave like structural geometry; force incompatible temporal scales to coexist in a lounge bar.
lyrics:
[INTRO]
[Spoken Administrative Patter, Dry and Clinical]
Attention entities. The geometric container has ingested an unauthorized potable substance.
[Instrumental Influx: Upright bass plucks a rigid waltz, organ swells in minor thirds]
[Verse 1]
[Close-Harmony Doo-Wop Vocals, Tight and Dry]
Four square walls are doing a liquid tilt,
Corners are leaking the milk they spilt,
Spheres are wearing a wobbling hat,
Tell me precisely what kind of room is that?
[Scat Interlude: Rapid syllables, sliding vocal registers]
Bip-bop-boodle-um, spill the floor,
Volume six is outside the door!
[Verse 2]
[Theatrical Speech-Song, Deadpan Precision]
The four-sided boss has been sipping the vat,
Now look at the corners, they do not stay put at!
Edges are drooping, the angles are slack,
There is no transit ticket to bring geometry back.
[Instrumental Break: Parlor organ trills, brushed snare drum roll, spring-reverb guitar twang]
[Chorus]
[Massed Choral Stack with Yodel Flips]
Tesseract drinking, the coordinates blink,
Edges are shrinking, the vertices sink!
Pour another gallon into the fourth dimension,
Listen closely to the structural tension!
Yodel-ay-hee-hoo, spill the base,
We are losing height in three-space!
[Bridge]
[Hocketing Vocal Fragments, Split syllables between left and right channels]
Tes-sa-
-ract-
-drin-
-king-
[Whispered Ensemble Rhythm under a full-voice lead]
Slosh, slosh, go the planes of glass,
Watch the hyper-cube collapse and pass.
[Spoken Interlude with Record Crackle SFX]
Notice: The volumetric capacity of the container has exceeded normal sobriety indices. Please hold your edges steady.
[Verse 3]
[Chromatic Cabaret Patter, Fast and Rhythmic]
Triangles staggered, rhombus is looped,
Every single azimuth has thoroughly drooped.
If a hyper-box benders on high-proof wine,
Do not expect a straight plumb line!
[Instrumental Outro: Walking bass accelerates, organ plays a dissonant cluster chord that abruptly cuts off into dead silence]
[Outro]
[Unison Whispered Chant]
Sober up the corners.
Lock the fourth dimension.
[Sudden silence]
caption: A retro lounge exotica and doo-wop vocal-group pop track where a tesseract gets drunk on geometry. Featuring close-harmony doo-wop, yodel register flips, walking upright bass, parlor organ, and spring-reverb guitar. The system compresses lyrical meter while stretching spatial reverb tails, treating topological collapse as a musical event.
